deck_title: Newell Stokes contour polygon normal vs naive three-vertex collinear collapse rig

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Martin Newell (1975) & Jim Blinn boundary-contour polygon normal vector (N_Newell = 0.5 * sum((v_i - v_{i+1}) x (v_i + v_{i+1})), which by Stokes theorem equals the exact total vector area of the polygon R = 1.0000x even when an edge vertex slides into a collinear T-junction) versus naive first-three-vertex cross product ((v_1 - v_0) x (v_2 - v_0), which shrinks as 1 - u and collapses to 0.0000x at u=1.0 across 16/17 stations) and 64-cell Stokes interior surface quadrature.
